shortDescription: Thoma Bravo-owned Proofpoint is in talks to buy cybersecurity firm Varonis Systems NASDAQ:VRNS, a source familiar with the matter told Reuters on Wednesday.Thoma Bravo, Proofpoint and Varonis did not immediately respond to Reuters requests for comment.
